description: This file is a CMake script that detects the build platform and sets corresponding variables or outputs messages indicating the platform, such as Linux, Windows, or macOS.

methods.name: if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
methods.description: Checks if the platform is Unix-like and not Apple, then sets the LINUX variable.

methods.name: if(WIN32 AND MSVC)
methods.description: Detects if building on Windows with MSVC compiler and sets the WIN_MSVC variable, then outputs a status message.

methods.name: elseif(MINGW)
methods.description: Checks for MinGW environment and outputs corresponding status message.

methods.name: elseif(LINUX)
methods.description: Detects Linux platform and outputs corresponding status message.

methods.name: elseif(APPLE)
methods.description: Detects macOS platform and outputs message.

methods.name: else()
methods.description: Handles unsupported platforms, outputs status with host system info.
